content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Primarily an electric utility; its telecom arm is secondary, and it lacks wireless and the Caribbean or South American footprint."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and operations software and outsourced IT services to operators, not connectivity services to subscribers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Voice-only long distance and VoIP reseller with no wireless or broadband networks, unlike the target's connectivity mix."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone software and web hosting for small businesses, not owned-network connectivity sold to rural subscribers."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Rural incumbent selling broadband, voice and business services over its own network to households and local businesses, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Designs communications hardware and software for carriers and enterprises, a vendor rather than a connectivity service provider."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Cloud communications and collaboration software for businesses, with no owned network or rural consumer connectivity."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Rural fiber broadband, voice and business network services over its own infrastructure, close to the target's fixed connectivity business."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Wireless and wireline broadband and voice to rural and midsize markets over owned networks, sold through stores and business contracts, like the target."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a leasing owner of fiber capacity to carriers; its retail broadband is a small side business, unlike the target's service model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Satellite connectivity and defense electronics with aviation and maritime focus, not terrestrial rural wireless and broadband service."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes network test equipment, optical components and security materials, a manufacturing and supply business rather than a service provider."}]}
